system.description:
When you **_wield the Scepter and incite an individual to violent action_**, you may erase 1 charge to roll +CHA: **on a 10+**, they must pick 1 from the list below; **on a 7-9**, they may choose to either lash out violently against a target of their choice or choose 1 from the list below.
- Act as you suggest, without doubt or fear, dealing +1d4 damage while they do so
- Resist, but suffer painful burns (2d4 damage, ignores armor).

success.value: they must pick 1 from the list below

partial.value: they may choose to either lash out violently against a target of their choice or choose 1 from the list below.
